function: The text-emphasis-position property specifies the position of the emphasis marks (over, under, left, right).

values.function: The emphasis marks are applied over the text (in horizontal writing mode)
The emphasis marks are applied under the text (in horizontal writing mode)
The emphasis marks are applied to the left of the text (in vertical writing mode)
The emphasis marks are applied to the right of the text (in vertical writing mode)
